original_sql:
SELECT s.shipment_id, c.carrier_name, s.weight
FROM shipments s, carriers c
WHERE s.carrier_id = c.carrier_id
  AND c.ship_mode = 'SEA'
gold_tuned_sql:
SELECT /*+ LEADING(c s) USE_NL(s) */ s.shipment_id, c.carrier_name, s.weight
FROM shipments s, carriers c
WHERE s.carrier_id = c.carrier_id
  AND c.ship_mode = :b1

diagnosis.risk_notes: 작은 테이블 드라이빙은 해당 테이블의 선택도가 유지될 때만 유효하다.
